Cautiously positive. The statement highlights strong labor markets, solid growth, and inflation near 2 percent, but adopts a “patient” stance due to global and financial developments and muted inflation. The May 2019 Financial Stability Report notes equity market volatility spiked around late 2018/early 2019 and financial stability concerns were elevated then, even though volatility declined by May. This context tempers the optimism in the January 2019 statement, so the tone is slightly less positive than 0.45.
